audit.whatIsWrong: The stored chart hands Teemo Levels 2, 3 and 6 and calls the first item 'Skill', while the packet chart gives Levels 2-4 to neither side and Level 6 and first item to Shen. The stored chart also contradicts its own copy: phases[4].why and whys[4] both call Level 6 Shen's clearest power spike, and the row says Teemo.
audit.why: Stand United is a 200s global that Teemo cannot answer or follow, and the matchup sits at 50.9% over 1448 games — Teemo owning five of seven rows cannot produce that. Levels 2-3 are genuinely even: Blinding Dart is 680 range against Shadow Dash's 600, but a baited blind gives Shen a clean taunt.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 and 2 to Skill, rows 4 and 5 to Shen; rows 0, 3 and 6 unchanged, so Teemo still owns Level 1 and the two-item shroom map. Ratings on the flipped rows moved off 2/10 to match. Proposed as matched full/content pairs.

audit.why: Four spikes present: Teemo Lvl 1-2, Shen Lvl 6, Shen first item, Teemo 2+ items. Order and timings are right — the chart rows were what disagreed with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) 'Move Quick passive' in mid and wants.foe[1] — Move Quick is his W (14s); his passive is Guerrilla Warfare, the brush stealth, which the page never mentions at all. (b) The decisive limit on Spirit's Refuge is never stated: it blocks basic attacks only, so Blinding Dart lands through it at full effect. (c) Twilight Assault's slow applies specifically while the target runs from Shen — the one thing that beats Move Quick — and is not mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's kit: P Guerrilla Warfare (invisible standing still, mobile invisibility in brush); W Move Quick, 14s; Q Blinding Dart, flat 7s at every rank, 680 range, projectile; E Toxic Shot, no cooldown, on-hit. Shen's W text is 'attacks that would hit Shen or his allies near his spirit blade are blocked' — attacks, not spells. The mirror audit on teemo__shen establishes all three points from the other side.
audit.corrected: Move Quick named as his W, Guerrilla Warfare written into the jungle/vision advice, the attacks-not-spells limit put in report[5].t, and the Q slow's run-away condition added to mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page is built on 'track Blinding Dart' and never states its cooldown.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is a flat 7 seconds at every rank — it never gets shorter, so a baited blind is a guaranteed seven-second window and that is the entire matchup. Toxic Shot has no cooldown at all, which is why Spirit's Refuge and MR, not armour, are the answer.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and whys[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Stack pure HP vs %damage' but its body is the generic split-push filler line, so the itemization point never actually lands.
audit.why: Missing-interactions flags onhit-itemization: Toxic Shot applies on-hit and scales with attack speed, so the trade reads wrong if you answer it with armour.
audit.corrected: Body rewritten to say what the title promises.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are a genuine skill-check. Your W zone is your equalizer — his Toxic Shot is auto-attack-based, so planting Spirit's Refuge directly on yourself during E-taunt eats a huge chunk of his trade damage. The dangerous trap is chasing: Teemo's Move Quick passive means he kites backward into brush, and chasing burns your Energy with no upside. Hold your E for an all-in or a hard punish, not a poke-back. At Level 6 the dynamic flips — Stand United lets you abandon the 1v1 completely and show up globally; Teemo is a poor 5v5 team fighter, and every fight you attend with a free global shield-plus-teleport is a fight he cannot answer.)
edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 are a genuine skill-check. Your W zone is your equalizer — Toxic Shot rides his basic attacks, so planting Spirit's Refuge on yourself during E-taunt eats a huge chunk of his trade damage; Blinding Dart is a spell and lands through it anyway. The trap is chasing: Move Quick (W) kites him into brush and burns your energy for nothing — but Twilight Assault slows him while he runs from you, so pulling the blade first is what makes a chase land. Hold E for an all-in, not a poke-back. At Level 6 the dynamic flips — Stand United lets you abandon the 1v1 and show up globally; Teemo is a poor 5v5 fighter, and every fight you attend with a free global shield-plus-teleport is one he cannot answer.

notes: Mirror reuse: all four point-4 findings from teemo__shen are restated here from Shen's side. The mirror's own note asks for a wider grep — 'Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks, not spells' is likely templated wrong across every Shen matchup against a spell-poke champion, not just Teemo; that is a champion-level cleanup outside this slice. suspectNames flagged 'Stand United', 'Toxic Shot' and 'Blinding Dart' — all three are FALSE POSITIVES and correct as written. The real name error the detector missed was 'Move Quick passive' (it is his W) in two fields. Level-chart flips are four matched pairs plus three rating adjustments on the same rows, proposed together as one group.
